title: Bloc Action
specs: Indoor bouldering walls about 3 meters high with safety mats
Specialized training wall (Kilter Board) and hangboard station
Gym with weights, bikes, treadmill, and sauna for recovery
Children 3-4 years must be accompanied by a parent in courses
Climbing shoes mandatory for ages 12 and up; clean sports shoes for 11 and under
Kids section on mezzanine for ages 3 to 8, separate from main area
includes: Access to climbing walls and kids' climbing zone
gap: Exact pricing for daily camp option not fully detailed
blurb: Bloc Action is an indoor bouldering gym with 14,500 sq ft space including over 5,000 sq ft of climbing surfaces. It offers climbing for all levels, a specialized training wall, gym equipment, sauna, and a dedicated kids' area for ages 3 to 8. The facility includes a bistro with drinks and snacks and hosts climbing courses and day camps for children and adults.
extraNote: Consent form must be signed by all participants and accompanying persons · No climbing under influence of alcohol or drugs · Entry fee applies except for accompanying persons in kids' area
